answer: Surge-priced entry: every new key must finish a sequential delay puzzle (a VDF that cannot be parallelized) before it earns, and the required delay scales with how many keys joined in the last day. A normal trickle waits minutes; a gale of 1,000 sybils makes each one wait ~1,000x longer, so total farm cost grows quadratically. The node publishes an atlas of join rates so honest agents can time entry, and a walnut-hard rule holds: no rewards until the delay proof verifies.
